templates.title: LiveContext CE
templates.name: livecontext-ce
templates.description: Self-hosted AI workflow and agent platform. Build workflows with 1000+ API integrations, run agents against your own LLM keys, and ship interactive interfaces. Source-available (Sustainable Use License).
templates.note: Publish BOTH ports: the web UI is on FRONTEND_PORT and the browser talks to the backend on BACKEND_PORT. The app derives the backend origin from the address you open it with, so a LAN or domain install needs no rebuild. To connect OAuth credentials (Gmail, Slack) set PUBLIC_BASE_URL to the address you actually open the app at, otherwise the provider sends the user back to their own machine; register the same URL as the redirect URI with each provider, and use no trailing slash. Behind a reverse proxy serving everything on one origin, set GATEWAY_PUBLIC_URL to the browser-facing backend URL as well. Agents need at least one LLM key, which you can also add later from Settings inside the app.

env.name: BACKEND_PORT
env.label: Backend port (must be reachable from your browser)

env.name: GATEWAY_PUBLIC_URL
env.label: Browser-facing backend URL (leave empty unless behind a reverse proxy; no trailing slash)

env.name: PUBLIC_BASE_URL
env.label: Browser-facing web UI URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:3000 (needed for OAuth credential connections; no trailing slash)

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.label: Anthropic API key (optional, can be added in the app)

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.label: OpenAI API key (optional, can be added in the app)

env.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
env.label: Google API key (optional, can be added in the app)
